title: Technical Recruiter
location: London; New York, NY, United States
description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Technical Recruiter to join our global Recruiting team. In this role, you will focus on hiring engineers across our Trading Technology (live trading environment) and Research & Development (enabling research) engineering teams. You will partner directly with hiring managers who have incredibly high standards, helping them navigate a competitive talent landscape. You will engage with deeply technical candidates, and manage the end-to-end hiring process for a variety of technical roles within HRT’s engineering ecosystem. 

HRT is one of the top quantitative trading firms in the world. We combine world-class engineering and scientific rigor with a low-ego, collaborative culture. Our people and our compute capabilities are our two most important differentiators, and that is where we are investing the most. We want recruiters who bring a unique perspective and curiosity, who can challenge the status quo of how to find the brilliant yet humble technical talent that make HRT so special. 

Responsibilities 

  • Partner directly with engineering leadership on recruitment strategy, and be a proactive and consultative strategic partner to hiring managers
  • Manage the end-to-end hiring pipelines of engineering roles from first outreach through offer acceptance, including navigating complex offer negotiations
  • Provide a high-touch, white-glove candidate experience across both opportunistic roles and high-volume pipelines
  • Apply an engineering mindset to your recruitment approach, continuously leveraging recruiting data & analytics to identify inefficiencies and iterate on your process
  • Build relationships with external recruitment agencies to generate high-quality candidate flow for your roles

title: Software Engineer - Treasury Infrastructure
description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to focus on our Treasury Infrastructure. Coders at HRT work on small, highly productive, and efficient teams that design, improve, and maintain the technology that powers worldwide trading — at HRT, the code you write is our business. You’ll have an opportunity to work closely with Treasury Quantitative Researchers and our Funding Team to design and develop HRT's Treasury Optimization and Research Platform.

We are looking for highly skilled programmers who love to code and solve complex problems, appreciate a culture of collaboration, and thrive in a performance-driven environment. You can always expect to be challenged by the ever-changing financial markets, and find yourself working on critical software in an extremely fast-paced, real-time environment.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the engineering design and development of HRT’s Treasury Optimization Platform.
  • Collaborate with Treasury Researchers on HRT’s Treasury Research Infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with Quantitative Developers as well as our Funding and Finance teams on managing cash and collateral requirements.

Qualifications

  • Completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. If you are currently pursuing your Bachelor's degree, please apply to our Campus/New Grad opportunities.
  • Working experience in Python and good CS fundamentals.
  • Proficiency with numerical computing libraries (Numpy, PyTorch, TensorFlow) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of global portfolio financing and funding is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with engineers, researchers, and non-technical teams.
